name: Lurfos the Herald

facts.text: Level 76, 30,000 health, slashing weapon. No scripted mechanic beyond his tether; he stands on the road to Orylle's hall (61: 31414, 65541).

story:
Every queen needs a herald, and Lurfos stands on the long road to Orylle's hall to announce whoever comes. He has a voice like a rockfall and a blade to match, and he takes the duty seriously: no one reaches the queen unannounced, and most who meet him are announced as dead. He is the last door before the deepest hall. The old heralds of Krondon carried a staff and a list of names; Lurfos carries a blade and no list, because he has never needed to remember anyone for long.

The last door. Every queen needs a herald, and when Orylle took the hall she put Lurfos on the long road to her chair, where the hall-folk's own heralds once stood with staves and lists of names. Lurfos has a voice like a rockfall and a blade to match, and he takes the duty seriously: no one reaches the queen unannounced, and most who meet him are announced as dead.

What he guards. He stands where the road to the deepest hall narrows, and the throw spot where Orylle hurls her challengers lies just behind him, so that a raider the queen has swept out lands within sight of her herald, and must walk back past him. The old heralds of Krondon carried a staff and a list of names; Lurfos carries a blade and no list, because he has never needed to remember anyone for long. The ghosts say he is the one ogre who stands exactly where his title says he should. They do not mean it as praise.
legend:
A straight fight: a big ogre with a big blade and nothing clever about him. Kill him clean, with no deaths and no wasted power, because the queen's hall is right behind him and you want your mana and your endurance for her.

Kill him before the queen fight, never during it: the walk back from her throw passes his post, and a living Lurfos on that road kills the thrown one by one. Old raid leaders use Lurfos to check the raid before the queen: if he costs you anyone, rest and rebuff before you go on. There is nothing behind him but Orylle, Orshom and the long walk back.

loremasterTopic.text: Orylle's herald. He stands on the road to the deepest hall and lets no one reach the queen unannounced. Fight him clean; she is behind him.

bookPage: On the road to the queen a great voice called out to know who came, and Sir Cador called back our realm and his name, and the voice said that we were announced, and then that we were dead. Lurfos stood where the road narrows, where the hall-folk's own heralds once stood with staves and lists. We killed him cleanly, because Cador had already been thrown once past that post on his first descent, and knew that the place where the queen throws her challengers lies just behind it, at the feet of a herald with a sword.
